20:62.text: Then they debated one with another what they must do, and they kept their talk secret.

20:63.text: They said: "Verily these are two magicians. Their object is to drive you out from your land with magic, and overcome your chiefs and nobles.

20:64.text: "So devise your plot, and then assemble in line. And whoever overcomes this day will be indeed successful."
